layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Dark theme container (#241A16) with canvas R3F overlay + fallback image. Sticky viewport height with progressive scroll transition.
layouts_and_grids.editorial_sections: Light theme (#F7F2E9 and #E8DED0) with generous spacing (py-24 to py-32), asymmetrical bento containers, high-contrast serif headers.
layouts_and_grids.menu_section: Filter tabs navigation + 13 categories bento grid / list toggle. Desktop: 2-column editorial card with image, title, price, badges, expandable ingredient drawer. Mobile: clean list with aligned right prices.
layouts_and_grids.specialties_carousel_grid: 3-column highlight bento grid with high-resolution imagery, subtle warm hover lift, caramel accent borders.
layouts_and_grids.gallery_grid: Masonry/bento style with lightbox modal trigger, keyboard traps, image metadata.
layouts_and_grids.practical_info_card: Split section: dark roasted coffee backdrop for map/info (+33 6 31 11 95 83, 46 Rue du Faubourg-National 67000 Strasbourg) + cream background for contact form.

scenery_flow.description: Photorealistic 3D roasted coffee bean floating in deep espresso space (#241A16), slow rotation, soft ambient warm lighting, subtle cursor tilt reaction. Progressive emergence of GALISTA CAFÉ logo.
Scroll progression: coffee bean dissolves into floating roast particles, espresso swirl particles, caramel reflections, steam micro-geometry.

Particle convergence reveals a cream ceramic cup & saucer with delicate cappuccino latte art and GALISTA CAFÉ insignia on cup wall. Slow orbit, reveal of core hero copy: 'L'art du café, tout simplement.' and CTA buttons.
Further scroll: cup glides gracefully to the right side, background blends into editorial cream (#F7F2E9) universe section seamlessly.

experience_3d_du_grain_a_la_tasse.fallback_requirements: WebGL detection: if unsupported or prefers-reduced-motion is active, render cinematic fallback image overlay with smooth CSS parallax.
experience_3d_du_grain_a_la_tasse.mobile_optimization: Simplified particle count (max 80 particles), locked frame rate cap, passive touch scroll listeners so 3D never captures or blocks scroll gesture.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per project setup.

Maintain strict data-testid attributes on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='lang-switcher-de', data-testid='category-filter-boreks', data-testid='cta-discover-menu', data-testid='contact-form-submit').
Ensure total responsive layout from 390px mobile screens to 1440px+ desktop.
Never block touch/scroll gestures on 3D canvas (use pointer-events-none on canvas container or handle non-interfering camera controls).
Include full French content as default with German (DE) and English (EN) dictionary support for all text strings.
Implement Sonner toast notifications upon contact form submission or address copy action.
Ensure high text contrast ratios across cream (#F7F2E9) and dark espresso (#241A16) backgrounds.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on fixed headers after scrolling — apply glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md with creme bg.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
